data.name: Husayn
data.gender_notes: Husayn is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the word 'hasan' meaning 'beauty'. It is often used to describe a small or little beauty. The name Husayn carries the meaning “Little Beauty” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Husayn usually hope their child will grow to embody little beauty and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The grandson of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) and the third Imam of Shia Muslims.
data.etymology: Husayn belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Little Beauty.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Husayn total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

in_arabic.name: حسين
in_arabic.meaning: حسن و جمیل، خوب صورت، نیکوصفت، عالی مرتبت
in_arabic.long_meaning: حسين بن علي بن أبي طالب، حفيد رسول الله، اسمه مشتق من جذر 'حسن' الذي يعني الجمال و الحسن، و هو اسم ذو دلالة على الرفعة و العلو، و يعتبر من الأسماء المحببة عند المسلمين لما له من ارتباط وثيق بتاريخ الإسلام و شخصية الإمام الحسين

in_urdu.name: حسین
in_urdu.meaning: حسن اور جمیل، خوب صورت، نیکوصفت، عالی مرتبت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حسین بن علی بن ابو طالب، رسول اللہ کا پوترا، اس کا نام 'حسن' کے جذر سے ماخوذ ہے جو کہ حسن اور جمال کو 의미 دیتا ہے، اور یہ نام رفعت اور علو کی دلالت کرتا ہے، اور مسلمانوں کے درمیان اس نام کو بہت اہمیت حاصل ہے کیونکہ اس کا تعلق اسلامی تاریخ اور امام حسین کی شخصیت سے ہے

in_hindi.name: हुसैन
in_hindi.meaning: हसन और जमील, خوب सूरत, नेकूसफ्त, عالی مرتبत
in_hindi.long_meaning: हुसैन बिन अली बिन अबू तालिब, रसूल अल्लाह के पोते, इसका नाम 'हसन' के जड़ से निकला है जो कि हसन और जमाल को दर्शाता है, और यह नाम उच्चता और उत्कृष्टता की ओर इशारा करता है, और मुसलमानों के बीच इस नाम का बहुत महत्व है क्योंकि इसका संबंध इस्लामी इतिहास और इमाम हुसैन की शख्सियत से है

in_pashto.name: حسين
in_pashto.meaning: حسن او جمیل، ښه سورت، نیکوصفت، عالی مرتبت
in_pashto.long_meaning: حسين بن علي بن ابو طالب، د رسول الله پوترا، ددې نوم مطلب د 'حسن' له ريښې څخه اخیستل شوی دی چې د حسن او جمال معنی ورکوي، او دا نوم د لوړوالي او عظمت دلالت کوي، او د مسلمانانو په منځ کې دا نوم ډیر اهمیت لري ځکه چې د اسلامي تاريخ او امام حسین سره تړاو لري

in_english.name: Husayn
in_english.long_meaning: Husayn, the grandson of the Prophet Muhammad, son of Ali ibn Abi Talib, derived from the Arabic root 'H-S-N' which means beauty, goodness, and excellence, a name that signifies elevation and nobility, highly revered in Islamic tradition for its association with Imam Husayn, a key figure in Islamic history and spirituality

data.cultural_impact: The name Husayn holds significant cultural impact as it is synonymous with pride, sacrifice, and bravery, representing the revered figure of Imam Husayn, the grandson of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH). He is renowned for leading a revolt against the Umayyad Caliph Yazid in the Battle of Karbala in 680 CE, which ultimately led to his martyrdom. Husayn ibn Ali's story has been narrated, painted, and sung throughout history - becoming a core theme in Islamic art, music, and literature. This legacy has embedded the significance of self-sacrifice, courage, and determination into the consciousness of many Islamic communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual standpoint, Husayn is regarded as a shining example of piety, courage, and self-sacrifice. His suffering, endurance, and eventual sacrifice have become a source of solace, inspiration, and spiritual guidance for generations of Muslims. The importance of Husayn and the event of Karbala teaches us the value of standing up for what is right, enduring hardships, and ultimately finding peace in sacrificing oneself for a noble cause. This spiritual significance is evident during religious commemorations like Mourning of Muharram, which are observed in reverence to Husayn's sacrifices and his unwavering commitment to truth and justice.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Husayn ibn Ali was the third son of Ali and Fatimah, and the grandson of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Husayn carried significant weight in that era.
He is considered a martyr in Shia Islam and is commemorated during the religious observance of Ashura.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Husayn remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
